features.note: Separate chapter/canon browsing with per-scope search, selection, expansion and scroll state; explicit navigation reveals its target.

Session-local task summary and logs; explicit review/discard, retained context snapshot, guarded commit, pending-result protection on new tasks/project switches/exit. Existing confirmation dialogs remain authoritative.

features.notes: Profile-local window geometry, sidebar preferences and per-project document/cursor/scroll restoration; missing-document fallback.
AI creation menu explains unavailable actions and offers chapter, project, task or settings navigation.
Saving feedback and persistent error banner; successful save clears failure; external revision conflicts remain protected.
Elided titles with full tooltips, clear empty-search action and locate-current-document shortcut button.
Ctrl+P searches current project navigation metadata across chapters and canon; recently opened documents first; save checks and project/path revalidation remain authoritative.

Ctrl+Shift+P searches existing actions with shortcut and unavailable-reason display; live availability checked before execution; F6 returns to editor, Ctrl+Alt+F searches directory, Ctrl+Alt+L locates current document. Focus-mode shortcuts remain available.
Writing, AI/connection, appearance and data tabs; collapsed advanced launcher options, conditional custom rows, inline argument errors with focus and scroll recovery.
Session-local draft retention across routes and theme changes; explicit save/discard, staged defaults, save failure feedback and exit guard; apply only edited values to current configuration.

Brand-free navigation rail; stronger light interaction blue; neutral layered dark surfaces; separate primary button/text colors and visible focus states. Previous stock palettes update while custom palettes are preserved.

Application-wide native caption theme for main windows and Qt dialogs; live switching, handle recreation and activation updates; high-contrast system-colour fallback. Windows 10 uses supported native dark framing; exact caption/text/border colours depend on Windows 11 DWM support.
